p: joy in thy strength: When he will overcome his enemies, and so be assured of his calling.
preventest him with the blessings of: You declared your liberal favour toward him before he prayed.
He asked life of thee: David not only obtained life, but also assurance that his posterity would reign forever.
blessed for ever: You have made him your blessings to others, and a perpetual example of your favour forever.
Thine hand shall find out all: Here he describes the power of Christ's kingdom against the enemies of it.
wrath: This teaches us patiently to endure the cross till God destroys the adversary.
intended evil against thee: They laid as it were their nets to make God's power bend to their wicked enterprises.
turn their back: As a mark to shoot at.
Be thou exalted: Maintain your Church against your adversaries that we may have ample opportunity to praise your Name.
